relevance_note: Cohort paper with a per-patient table of NOD2 mutation carriers with PGA: "Demographic, genetic and clinical information of all symptomatic subjects with NOD2 mutations" (45 subjects), plus four asymptomatic E383K carriers described in the text.
method_note: A Python script (scratch build.py) transcribed Table 1 (45 rows; columns Subject no., Family no., Family member, Sex, Onset age (mos.), NOD2, Arthritis, Uveitis, Rash, Extended Phenotype); the transcription was checked against the table, and all text-derived facts were entered by hand from my reading. Labels: Table 1 has a column of bare subject numbers, so patients are labelled 'Table 1 #<n>'; the text refers to the same people as '#7', '# 27', 'Patient #27' (the table index), and these were mapped to the same labels. The four asymptomatic E383K carriers (Results, 'Asymptomatic carrier state'; table footnote # on family 22) have no labels: 'unnamed person 1'-'3' are the three younger than 4 years, 'unnamed person 4' the 40-year-old adult male. Table conventions: '?' is defined as unavailable and recorded as not reported; 'No' in the Arthritis, Uveitis and Rash columns is recorded as excluded (an explicit word, not a symbol); Uveitis severity (Severe/Mod./Mild) goes to severity_or_detail, and 'Severe' (legend: significant visual loss) also gives visual impairment observed. 'None' in the Extended Phenotype column was NOT used to exclude any specific feature (it does not name which features are absent, and the text says fever 'may have been underreported'). Checklist 'arthritis or joint synovitis' left not reported for the two 'No' arthritis subjects (#14, #37) under the narrow/broad rule. Inheritance: recorded inherited maternal/paternal only for the seven Table 1 'Proband' rows whose family has a 'Mother' or 'Father' row carrying the same NOD2 mutation (families 1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 24, 29); siblings, the father in family 1 (PGM row) and others left not reported. Zygosity is never stated. Variant strings are protein-level one-letter descriptions as printed (e.g. R334W); no cDNA or transcript is printed. is_proband: true for 'Proband', false for relatives, null for 'Sporadic'. 'Large vessel vasculopathy ... was not observed in this series' was applied as a named-group exclusion to all 45 table subjects (not to the asymptomatic carriers); it is narrower than the checklist vasculitis item, which stays not reported. 'None showed positive Antinuclear Antibodies or Rheumatoid Factor' was not used: its group (all patients or the four Spanish patients with biopsy) is ambiguous. 'There were no cases of either periodic or hectic fever' was not used (group not named). cohort_size_as_stated left null: the paper gives 128 International Registry and 12 Spanish entries plus 26 wild-type patients, but no single stated study total. Discrepancies in the paper: (1) the Pneumonitis section names patient '# 6' (fever, adenopathy, ground glass opacities), but Table 1 gives #6 'None' and lists 'Lung' and 'Fever' for #7; both are recorded as stated (#6 from the text, #7 from the table). (2) The Cranial neuropathies section gives inflammatory optic neuropathy to # 38, while Table 1 lists 'ION' for #35 and 'Cranial neuropathy' for #38; both recorded as stated. (3) Results text says 'two without rash' and the Discussion says rash in '40/45', but Table 1 has three 'No' (#18, #35, #37) and one '?' (#17). (4) Text says 7 individuals had fever; Table 1 lists fever for 6 (#7, #27, #34, #35, #36, #37), and #6 has fever in the text. (5) The Discussion cites hypertension in '# 7, #9 and #23' while #40 is also hypertensive. Workup for #7's hypertension 'has been negative' (whole work-up) excludes nothing specific. Treatment summaries come from the text only.
